📌 September 21 Anti-Corruption Rallies (Luneta & EDSA)

Why it matters:
✔️The rallies target massive corruption in flood control projects (₱1.9T spent over 15 years, half allegedly lost).

✔️Reminder that corruption is not tied to party colors—“politicians and contractors… worship the color of money.”

✔️Call for unity across faith, politics, and social classes to reclaim the nation from corruption.

Where & When:
📍Luneta / Rizal Park, Manila
Rally: “Baha sa Luneta: Aksyon na Laban sa Korapsyon” 
Time: 9:00 AM
Organized by: University students, activist groups, environmental coalitions.

📍People Power Monument, EDSA
Rally: “Trillion Peso March”
Time: 2:00 PM
Organized by: Catholic & Protestant leaders (CLCNT), 1Sambayan, civil society orgs, labor & women’s groups.
Attendees encouraged to wear white shirts (symbol of unity & hope).
